name: An agent's scopes are kept on the agent; a new credential carries exactly them
summary: Stored agent scopes govern plain renewal; dead or wider old credentials never reset them. Legacy equal working credentials give uncertain inferred scopes: expiry/revocation may leave one unintended credential. Only the owning account confirms by plain renewal; a superuser gets409 scopes_needed and must send a list. Unknown or malformed stored scopes never infer authority; an explicit owner list repairs them. Widening is owner-only403; other authorized lists may narrow. Requests require known scope names, duplicates count once, empty means no list; malformed stored duplicates are unknown. Labels are at most64 printable characters. Reads do not confirm. At most20 working credentials/newest5 dead; pruning removes token indexes. Issue/revoke audit actor/time/request, agent/credential IDs, credential scopes and scopes/source before/after; changes add agents.scopes, within retention, without secrets/labels/hashes. Failed persistence rolls back scopes, credentials, pruning, indexes and committed audit; no secret is returned. The page explains unknown/inferred/old-service uncertainty, permits owner repair and an authorized superuser filter.
